name: The Seven Bad Apples
source:
It’s been some weeks since Ranko and Astrid solved the mystery aboard the Marine Express submarine train during the special trip organized by St. Joachim Academy, the school they attend. Their lives have returned to normal, but that doesn’t mean there won’t be any more mysteries to solve in the future. The day before the school’s big Christmas festival, the two friends are finishing their second term exams, but despite this being a crucial time for the alumni, the girls find themselves drawn into solving a new enigma.

A first-year student, Veronica Bell, approaches them to ask for their help investigating the disappearance of the sheet music for the big choir concert, which is scheduled as the final event before the school holidays. She suspects that one of the rebellious singers, known as “the Seven Bad Apples” of the academy, has hidden the scores in order to cancel the concert and avoid having to perform. Veronica needs those back before the performance the following day, so they decide to help her find them.

Join Ranko and Astrid in this short Xmas-y adventure and solve the mystery of the missing scores before it’s too late!
translation:
兰科和阿斯特丽德在他们就读的学校圣约阿希姆学院组织的特别旅行中解开了海洋快车潜艇列车上的谜团，已经过去了几周的时间。他们的生活已经恢复正常，但这并不意味着未来不会有更多的谜团需要解开。在学校盛大的圣诞节的前一天，这两个朋友即将完成第二学期的考试，尽管这对校友来说是一个关键时刻，但女孩们发现自己陷入了解决一个新谜题的过程中。

一年级学生维罗妮卡·贝尔 (Veronica Bell) 找到他们，请求他们帮助调查大型合唱团音乐会乐谱的失踪事件，该音乐会被安排为学校假期前的最后一场活动。她怀疑其中一位被称为学院“七个坏苹果”的叛逆歌手隐藏了乐谱，以便取消音乐会并避免演出。维罗妮卡需要在第二天演出前取回这些东西，所以他们决定帮助她找到它们。

与兰科和阿斯特丽德一起参加这个短暂的圣诞冒险，并在为时已晚之前解开失踪乐谱之谜！
